versions.content: Calculate an approximation of the reciprocal of the square root of ValValue (1/sqrt(ValValue)). The accuracy of the result is no less than 6.75 bits, and therefore always within +/- 1 % of the accurate result. This instruction can be used to implement a floating-point square root function in soft- ware using the Newton-Raphson iterative method.
